summary: Creates or removes holes in enclosed polygonal or Bezier face regions by detecting interior faces and building/removing bridges.

key_params.name: unbridge
key_params.note: Remove detected bridges from existing holes.

key_params.name: snap
key_params.note: Snap rotated or translated hole points onto the outline plane.

common_gotchas: Hole SOP is polygonal/Bezier oriented; NURBS conversion can change downstream primitive assumptions.
`snap` can avoid twisted faces when hole points are off the outline plane.
`unbridge` changes topology and can disrupt later index-based SOP operations.
key_concepts: Hole SOP creates or removes holes by detecting enclosed faces and bridge geometry.
It supports polygonal and Bezier geometry; NURBS are internally converted to Beziers.
Interior faces do not need to be coplanar or share orientation with exterior faces.
`unbridge` removes bridge geometry rather than creating a new hole.
